places.name: Jiufen Old Street
places.ai_summary: A charming mountain town known for its narrow streets, tea houses, and stunning views of the coastline.
places.place_tip: Try the local taro balls and enjoy the sunset view.
places.address: Jiufen, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.ai_summary: A historic street famous for releasing sky lanterns and its proximity to the Shifen Waterfall.

places.ai_summary: A unique geological park featuring the iconic Queen's Head rock formation and other natural wonders.

places.address: Yehliu Village, Wanli District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Keelung Miaokou Night Market
places.ai_summary: A famous night market in Keelung known for its wide variety of street food and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is during dinner hours.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the seafood stalls and the local delicacies.
places.address: Keelung, Taiwan

places.name: Heping Island Park (Keelung)
places.ai_summary: A scenic park in Keelung offering beautiful coastal views, walking trails, and historical sites.
places.place_tip: Explore the coastal trails and visit the old fort.
places.address: Heping Island, Keelung, Taiwan

places.name: Tamsui Old Street & Fort San Domingo
places.ai_summary: A historic area in Tamsui with a well-preserved old street, Fort San Domingo, and beautiful river views.

opening_hours.notes: Fort San Domingo last entry at 17:00.

places.place_tip: Visit the fort for a glimpse of history and a great view of the sunset.
places.address: Tamsui, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.place_tip: Rent a bike to explore the park and enjoy the riverside breeze.
places.address: Bali, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.ai_summary: A popular waterfront area in Tamsui with a fishing wharf, seafood restaurants, and the iconic Lover’s Bridge.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the late afternoon or evening.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a seafood dinner at the wharf and take a stroll on Lover’s Bridge.

places.place_tip: Try the local herbal rice cake and peanut ice cream roll.
places.address: Ruifang, New Taipei City, Taiwan
